title: Pure Nouvelles

allow.Patissciel Couverture: The one Patissciel card Concours de Cuisine needs: it goes to the opponent's field in Attack Position, where the Nouvelles Ritual Monsters tribute it. The page's core combo is built on this pair.

summary: Pure Nouvelles Ritual build with Recipe Spells and Traps, one allowed Patissciel Couverture in the Extra Deck for Concours de Cuisine, and generic staples. Whenever a Nouvelles Ritual Monster on the field is targeted by a card or effect, or targeted for an attack, it tributes an Attack Position monster on the field (including the opponent's) to Special Summon the next higher-Level Nouvelles Ritual Monster from the hand or Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Poissonniere de Nouvelles (Level 1 Pendulum) searches a Level 1 Ritual Monster or any Recipe card when Normal or Special Summoned, and places itself in the Pendulum Zone if Tributed for a Ritual Summon.

Chef de Nouvelles searches any non-Pendulum Nouvelles card from the Deck and Special Summons itself from the Pendulum Zone, while Voici la Carte (Today's Menu) reveals 2 Nouvelles with different names so the opponent picks one to add to your hand alongside its matching Recipe Ritual Spell.

Concours de Cuisine (Culinary Confrontation) Special Summons Poissonniere de Nouvelles to your field and Patissciel Couverture from your Extra Deck to the opponent's field in Attack Position, giving your Nouvelles a guaranteed Attack Position target to tribute.

summary.title: Opening: Poissonniere + Voici la Carte (or Concours de Cuisine)
steps: Normal Summon Poissonniere de Nouvelles (or summon it with Concours de Cuisine alongside Patissciel Couverture on their field) to search Recette de Poisson (Fish Recipe) or Buerillabaisse de Nouvelles.

Ritual Summon Level 1 Buerillabaisse de Nouvelles using Recette de Poisson by tributing Poissonniere; Buerillabaisse excavates 5 cards for a Nouvelles card, Recette de Poisson searches Recette de Viande (Meat Recipe), and Poissonniere places itself in your Pendulum Zone.

Activate Poissonniere's Pendulum Effect to target Buerillabaisse on the field and move Poissonniere to the Monster Zone; because Buerillabaisse was targeted by an effect, tribute Buerillabaisse and an Attack Position monster (such as Couverture on their field) to Special Summon Level 3 Poeltis de Nouvelles from the Deck, then climb into Level 5 Balameuniere de Nouvelles.

summary.title: Targeting Triggers & Climbing Courses
summary.text: The lower-course Rituals (Level 1 Buerillabaisse and Level 2 Confiras) trigger when they themselves are targeted by a card or effect, tributing themselves and another Attack Position monster on either field to summon a Level 2/3 or Level 3/4 Nouvelles. The middle courses (Level 3 Poeltis and Level 4 Foie Glasya) trigger as a Quick Effect whenever any monster on the field is targeted by a card or effect, tributing any Nouvelles you control plus another Attack Position monster on either field to summon a Level 4/5 or Level 5/6 Nouvelles. You can self-target your own monsters with Poissonniere's Pendulum Effect or Chef de Nouvelles's Level boost to climb on demand.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Balameuniere de Nouvelles (Level 5) searches any Nouvelles or Recipe card on Special Summon, and tributes 1 Attack Position monster the opponent controls (as a Quick Effect if summoned by a Nouvelles monster's effect) to Special Summon Level 6 Baelgrill de Nouvelles from the hand or Deck.

Baelgrill de Nouvelles (Level 6) negates the effects of all face-up cards the opponent currently controls on Special Summon, and if summoned by a Nouvelles monster's effect, also tributes all monsters the opponent controls before summoning Hungry Burger (or Angry Burger, which is treated as Hungry Burger).
Chef de Nouvelles, while on the field, reacts to an opponent's Special Summon by banishing a Recipe Ritual Spell from the hand, Deck, or GY to copy its Ritual Summon effect.

summary.title: Recipes & Left out
points: Nouvelles Restaurant "At Table" searches a Recipe card from the Deck or GY and recycles GY cards in the End Phase to draw 1 card.

Chef's Special Recipe is an omni-negate Counter Trap while you control a Nouvelles Ritual Monster and banishes itself from the GY when you summon Hungry Burger (or Angry Burger) to tribute all opponent's monsters; Recette de Personnel (Staff Recipe) spawns a Nouvelles Token and Ritual Summons on the opponent's turn.
Left out: Nouvelles Recipe Book "Recettes de Nouvellez" is not yet released in the TCG.
